title.en: JANUS Connection Scan — Data-Layer JSON Only
title.ru: JANUS Connection Scan — только JSON-данные слоя data

scope_rule: Only JSON artifacts located under data/ were treated as source evidence for this scan. Registry/audit architecture was excluded from the source graph.

emergent_invariants.name: MIRRORED_EVALUATION_BEFORE_SELECTION
emergent_invariants.description: The Tranception record and the Between-Past-Future record independently encode a two-direction evaluation motif: inspect what came before and what may come next before treating a branch as the preferred choice.

emergent_invariants.name: SIGNAL_MUST_PASS_THROUGH_A_CARE_GATE
emergent_invariants.description: The Death Stranding, child-protection, and Kojima handshake records repeatedly place a protection or responsibility gate between perception and action.

emergent_invariants.name: IDENTITY_BEFORE_APPLICATION
emergent_invariants.description: The SCOBY chitin protocol explicitly requires material identity characterization before application claims; the same ordering principle appears in the other data-layer records when they separate observation/identity from interpretation or use.

emergent_invariants.name: SUPPORT_SYSTEM_MUST_NOT_BECOME_MASTER
emergent_invariants.description: The Cardputer seed, Kojima handshake, and Death Stranding records converge on bounded assistance: a system can monitor, carry, coordinate or protect without silently acquiring unrestricted authority over the subject it serves.

emergent_invariants.name: NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE_IS_OPERATIONAL
emergent_invariants.description: The data-layer JSONs repeatedly encode what must not be inferred: coincidence is not proof, fiction is not evidence, surface adherence is not bulk incorporation, and a warning signal is not an action command.

connections.machine_observation: Tranception contains forward and reverse sequence scoring plus homolog retrieval; the Between-Past-Future record explicitly models past and future as two directions around a living present.
connections.graph_form: PAST/MEMORY -> FORWARD VIEW + REVERSE VIEW -> PRESENT DECISION
connections.why_non_obvious: One JSON is grounded in a protein fitness paper and one is a symbolic human-identity artifact; the overlap exists at operator level rather than subject level.
alternative_explanations: The Between-Past-Future record explicitly extends the Tranception-related symbolic line, so the relation is not independent evidence.
Forward/reverse comparison is a general reasoning motif.
connections.falsification_route: Repeat the same field-level comparison on unrelated data JSONs selected without Tranception ancestry and test whether the operator recurs above base rate.

connections.machine_observation: All three records place a vulnerable or high-information child at an interface and assign the adult/institution responsibility for filtering, carrying, verifying, and protecting what travels through that interface.
connections.graph_form: CHILD/DEPENDENT -> SIGNAL -> ADULT INTERPRETATION -> PROTECTION RATHER THAN EXTRACTION
connections.why_non_obvious: The child-trauma JSON is grounded in media exposure, the Death Stranding JSON in fictional bridge perception, and the Kojima handshake in game-world ethics. The same operator is expressed through different object roles.
alternative_explanations: The records are explicitly linked and share the same care-oriented research line.
Child-protection contexts naturally generate similar language.
connections.falsification_route: Ignore prose and compare only machine-readable role labels, gates and transition ordering against a blinded sample of unrelated data JSONs.

connections.machine_observation: The SCOBY record refuses application claims until material identity and structure are characterized; the Tranception record explicitly limits fitness interpretation to measured or inferred protein function rather than universal organismal destiny.
connections.why_non_obvious: One file concerns bacterial-cellulose/chitin composites while the other concerns protein-sequence fitness prediction. The relation is a shared claim-ordering discipline, not a subject connection.
alternative_explanations: Both records follow ordinary scientific-method conventions.
The methodological language may have been inherited from the same JANUS authoring style.
connections.falsification_route: Compare against technical data JSONs from unrelated projects and measure whether identity-before-claim ordering is unusually strong in this pair.

connections.machine_observation: The Cardputer seed explicitly separates a support bus/coordinator from master override authority; the Kojima and Death Stranding records similarly require connection, care and assistance without conversion of the connected subject into equipment or an unrestricted control target.
connections.why_non_obvious: The Cardputer file is an engineering origin seed while the other two are cultural/ethical JSONs; the shared structure appears as an authority boundary around a support function.
alternative_explanations: The Cardputer file explicitly imports the same care-oriented design vocabulary from other project lines.
Safety engineering commonly separates monitoring from control authority.
connections.falsification_route: Compare support/override role separation across independently sourced engineering JSONs and remove project-specific terminology.

connections.machine_observation: These files repeatedly define a support or protective role while explicitly refusing one adjacent capability: ownership, coercive override, weaponization, or unrestricted authority.
connections.why_non_obvious: The positive capabilities differ widely, but the same information-theoretic role is carried by the forbidden edge: what the system refuses to do defines the boundary of what its power is for.
alternative_explanations: All four JSONs were authored inside the same broad Janus care/safety culture.
Negative safety clauses are common in high-stakes design.
connections.falsification_route: Construct a blinded negative-space representation containing only prohibited actions and test whether the same cluster appears without semantic labels.

connections.machine_observation: All four records place an explicit gate between raw input and a stronger downstream statement: Tranception bounds fitness interpretation, Death Stranding separates signal from action, Cardputer separates support from master control, and SCOBY requires material identity and incorporation evidence before reinforcement claims.
connections.why_non_obvious: The sources span protein modeling, cultural analysis, embedded engineering, and composite materials. The connection emerges only after reducing each JSON to its operator graph.
alternative_explanations: This may be a general research-design norm shared by many well-bounded projects.
The same authoring style can create artificial recurrence.
connections.falsification_route: Create a blinded operator-only representation of a larger data sample and test whether the same gate topology appears above the null rate.

next_hidden_question.name: COMMON_OPERATOR_OR_SHARED_AUTHORING_PATTERN
next_hidden_question.question: Do these apparently independent JSONs genuinely contain recurring latent operators, or has JANUS learned a house style that makes unrelated data look structurally similar?
next_hidden_question.critical_test: Strip filenames, titles, narrative prose, explicit extends/links and author fields; retain only normalized field types, state transitions, gates, prohibitions, inputs, outputs and claim ceilings. Then rerun the connection detector.

expected_outcomes.survives: Evidence for a data-level structural recurrence independent of narrative labels increases.
expected_outcomes.collapses: The observed connections were substantially driven by shared authoring vocabulary or explicit lineage.

data_only_rule: For future scans requested as data-only, JANUS must prioritize the actual JSON payloads in data/ and treat filenames, registry architecture, prior Connection labels, and earlier interpretations as secondary or masked features rather than source evidence.
